title: Understanding Bias and Variance
text: When you average predictions from multiple models, think about how each model's errors might interact. Consider how combining models might affect the overall error in terms of bias and variance.

title: Effect on Bias
text: Averaging predictions from multiple models can help reduce bias if the models are diverse. Think about how different perspectives might balance out systematic errors.

title: Effect on Variance
text: Consider how variance is affected when you combine predictions. If each model has its own variance, what happens when you average them?

title: Bias Change
text: How does averaging predictions from multiple models generally affect the bias of the combined model?

title: Variance Change
text: How does averaging predictions from multiple models generally affect the variance of the combined model?
